_comment: Copy to config.system.json for machine-wide defaults. ONLY the keys below are read by the code — verified against every load_system_config() call site. Render settings (resolution, fps, encoder, background style, blur) are CLI flags on `mediaconductor video` / `video-render`, not config keys; setting them here would silently do nothing.

bgm._comment: Background music bed. `file` is one track and wins; `directory` picks the first audio file in a folder. Both accept a Windows absolute path ("D:/bgm/tapion.wav" or "D:\\bgm\\tapion.wav"), a Linux absolute path ("/home/me/bgm/tapion.wav"), or a path relative TO THIS FILE ("bgm/tapion.wav") — never relative to the current directory. Override per run with --background-music.
bgm._volume_comment: volume_db is how far the bed sits BELOW the measured narration loudness. Keep new values within -20..-32; -30 is the shipped default.

tts._comment: engine: auto | indextts | kokoro. speaker_wav is the IndexTTS voice-clone reference — a clean 10-30s sample of the narrator. With none, `--tts auto` falls back to Kokoro. Same path rules as bgm: Windows absolute, Linux absolute, or relative to THIS FILE. Override per run with --speaker-wav.

manga_video._comment: audio_source stays 'faded' in production: raw clip edges click. 'raw' is a diagnostic override.

cut_page._comment: Fallback panel reading order when the source language is unknown. `download` normally records it in manga.json and page-split resolves it automatically.

paths._comment: library_subdir renames data/library/. It is validated as a relative subpath, so it cannot escape data/.
